name: spaceterm
description: Multiple terminals on a zoomable canvas

scripts.daemon:build: (cd pty-daemon && go build -o pty-daemon .) && echo 'Note: this only builds the binary. If a daemon is already running, use: npm run daemon:dev'
scripts.server:dev: sh -c 'while :; do tsx src/server/index.ts; status=$?; [ "$status" -eq 75 ] || exit "$status"; done'
scripts.client:dev: sh -c 'while :; do electron-vite dev; status=$?; [ "$status" -eq 75 ] || exit "$status"; done'
scripts.start: npm run client:build && concurrently --restart-tries -1 --restart-after 0 "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:preview"
scripts.get-env: op item get 'Anthropic Platform' --vault='Engineering' --fields label=ANTHROPIC_ORG_ID,label=ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID --format json | node -e "const f=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); process.stdout.write(f.map(x=>x.label+'='+x.value).join('\n')+'\n')" > .env && echo '.env written from 1Password'
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run client:build && npm run daemon:build && node scripts/ensure-electron-binary.mjs && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs
